title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Sturdy.....not! Wish I had not purchased this chair. Surely there must be a rolling chair that is sturdy for this price!

product_metadata.title: Boss Office Products Fabric Steno Chair in Black
features: One touch adjustment instantaneously raises or lowers chair
5 star nylon base allows smooth movement
Durable plastic protects seat back and bottom from tears
description: The Boss Black Fabric Steno Chair by Boss Office Products offers ease of use with its one touch lever that adjusts the seat to your height. The chair measures 22" W x 22" D x 29.5-33.5" H and is on the smaller side weighing just 16 pounds with a weight capacity of 150 pounds. Created with a 5-star nylon base, users will love the stability of the unit, as well as its ability to quickly roll from one side of the room to the other. The black crepe upholstery is stylish, while the plastic seat back and bottom offer practicality.
